# Arm kit (generated by build.py)

What the swap from the catch robot to the arm robot takes off and puts on (design.md 12.3). The base, the head, the face mast (the face, speaker and mics) and the electronics bay stay; the camera bar turns to its arm index; the kits' harnesses plug into the plate's payload connector panel.

Arm robot: **9.18 kg**, CG at [7.3, 0.0, 119.9] mm (the SO-101 stowed, est).
